_help.maxDeployAmount: Hard ceiling on SOL deployed per position.
_help.minFeeActiveTvlRatio: Min fee/active-TVL ratio (%), measured over `timeframe`. Scale this with the timeframe.
_help.minVolume: Min pool volume (USD) over `timeframe`. Scale this with the timeframe.
_help.minBinStep: Min DLMM bin step allowed for deploy.
_help.maxBinStep: Max DLMM bin step allowed for deploy.
_help.timeframe: Screening window: 5m|15m|1h|2h|4h|24h. Pool metrics (volume, fee/TVL, volatility) are measured over this window.
_help.category: Meteora pool-discovery category filter (e.g. trending, top).
_help.minTokenFeesSol: Min all-time global fees paid by the token (SOL). Below this = likely bundled/scam. Hard rule.
_help.maxBundlePct: Max bundle-holding % (OKX). Context only, NOT a hard filter.
_help.maxTop10Pct: Max top-10 holder concentration %. Hard filter.
_help.blockedLaunchpads: Launchpads to never deploy into, e.g. ["pump.fun", "letsbonk.fun"].
_help.allowedLaunchpads: If non-empty, only deploy into these launchpads.
_help.minTokenAgeHours: Min token age in hours (null = no minimum).
_help.maxTokenAgeHours: Max token age in hours (null = no maximum).
_help.athFilterPct: Only deploy if price is >= this % below ATH, e.g. -20 (null = off).
_help.maxPriceVolatility: Max % price swing during a position (learning metric, auto-evolved).
_help.maxVolatility: Max pool volatility at screening time (~0-5 typical, 5+ high). Hard filter + auto-evolved.
_help.autoSwapAfterClaim: Auto-swap claimed base token back to SOL after a standalone claim.
_help.outOfRangeBinsToClose: If active bin is this many bins ABOVE range, close (pumped far above).
_help.oorCooldownTriggerCount: OOR closes within the window before a pool/token goes on cooldown.
_help.oorCooldownHours: Cooldown duration (hours) after repeated OOR closes.
_help.stopLossPct: Close if PnL drops to this % (negative).
_help.takeProfitFeePct: Static take-profit when PnL reaches this %.
_help.minFeePerTvl24h: Min fee/TVL (24h, fixed window) before closing for low yield.
_help.minAgeBeforeYieldCheck: Minutes before the low-yield close rule can trigger.
_help.minSolToOpen: Min wallet SOL before opening a new position.
_help.positionSizePct: Fraction of deployable balance to use (compounds with wallet).
_help.trailingTriggerPct: Activate trailing once PnL reaches this %.
_help.trailingDropPct: Close when PnL drops this % from the confirmed peak.
_help.pnlSanityMaxDiffPct: Max diff between reported and derived PnL % before ignoring a tick.
_help.solMode: Report positions/PnL/balances in SOL instead of USD.
_help.strategy: Default LP strategy when signals are unclear: bid_ask|spot|curve.
_help.targetDownsidePct: Bin range covers this % price drop below the active bin.
_help.targetUpsidePct: Bin range covers this % price rise above the active bin (spot only).
_help.maxTokens: Max output tokens per LLM call.
_help.maxSteps: Max ReAct steps per agent run.
_help.darwin: Adaptive signal-weighting (off by default). Set { "enabled": true } to turn on; signal-weights.js reads windowDays/minSamples/boostFactor/decayFactor/weightFloor.
_help._meta: Generated template. Defaults mirror config.js (runtime source of truth). Keys here are flat; `darwin` is a nested object. `_help` is ignored by the app. Secrets (wallet, API keys) belong in .env, not here.
